note: Skillup VR is the product name; the company is Simlogic AB (Gothenburg, Sweden) with Simlogic Solutions Pte Ltd in Singapore. The pages read were saved from skillupvr.com, the corrected website (see the type note in config/competitors.csv). The More Products page also lists non-healthcare VR (a crane simulator) and BraveSteps VR for teenagers; these are not part of the medical simulation platform. The homepage outcome figures (for example '40% reduction in medical error') are the company's claims with no source named on the page.

product_category.value: VR medical simulation platform (a virtual simulation centre) for clinical team training, with a web-based scenario customizer and learning management platform.

evidence.quote:
VR Medical Simulation Centre
For critical thinking, clinical diagnosis, and collaborative team training
Run our web-based scenario customizer and learning management platform using Chrome, Edge, Safari web browser.
Download our application onto your VR headset and login with your credentials to start.
Developed for wireless headset to ensure mobility, and simple setup.

platforms.note: The web-based scenario customizer and learning management platform run in a browser, but they are used to set up scenarios and track performance, so Web is not listed for learners. 'Wireless and mobile' refers to the headset, not phones, so Mobile is not listed. No headset brand or model is named.

key_capabilities.note: Artificial intelligence is described as 'coming soon' on the Company page, so it is not listed. 'Training with colleagues at other locations' comes from a customer quote on the homepage.

target_customer.value: Medical teams and healthcare professionals in hospitals (trauma and emergency teams, including medium-sized hospitals) and vocational schools; VR Nurse Sim is for junior healthcare professionals. A Vinnova grant covers team training for civilian and military medics.

evidence.quote: to better prepare and equip medical teams for safer patient care
addresses space constraints and limited resources faced by medium-sized hospitals
VR Nurse Sim is designed for junior healthcare professionals to practice their basic nursing skills.
Simlogic awarded Vinnova Grant for Dual Purpose VR Team Training for Civilian and Military Medics.

target_customer.note: Customer quotes on the homepage come from Norwegian hospitals and a vocational school (Fagskolen Rogaland).

value_proposition.value: Replace or supplement conventional simulation with scalable VR team training that the company says takes less time, costs less than high-fidelity manikin simulation and improves patient safety.

evidence.quote: Transform Conventional Simulation, Unleash Scalable Learning Efficiency, Improve Patient Safety
More than 70% cost savings vs high fidelity manikin simulation.
22% less time than high-fidelity simulation.
